From The Grateful Dead · Price: weaker against cold creatures, and it stops on anyone who chills themselves (ice, cold water).

Theme Affliction

  • 1: 1 action: aura of gas, @Template[emanation|distance:20]{20-ft emanation}, for 1 minute (concentrate): non-allies that start their turn in it are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{fatigued} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 1} until the end of their turn (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates); allies are affected on a critical failure. Or, 1 action: your stand grips a creature within reach and withers it: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[force]] damage (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}); @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 1} until the end of your next turn on a failure, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 2} for 1 minute on a critical failure.
  • 5: Surge: your stand's touch ages a creature rapidly: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[force]] damage rolled with d4s instead of d6s (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}); on a failure it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{drained 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1} for 1 round; on a critical failure it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{drained 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1} for 1 minute.
  • 9: Aura 30 ft.
  • 13: The touch deals @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{drained 2}.
  • 17: Creatures that critically fail the aura save are also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1}.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
